messages:
marie: Quick sync — proposing a tiny floating toolbar for streaming: Stop, compact token counter, prompt-lib quick-insert. Figma: https://redwood.design/mini-toolbar-new2

ash: Desktop-first? placement notes?

marie: Bottom-right above composer. Collapses to single icon on narrow widths. If suggestions open, nudge left.

sam: Dev note: debounce token updates to 200-300ms to avoid reflow. Stop = cancel request.

ben: Hover on prompt-lib shows +N tokens. Keyboard focus shows tooltip too.

kai: A11y: aria-live="polite" for streaming region, token meter needs aria-label, toolbar must be tabbable.

a11y-bot: Checklist: keyboard-only flow, NVDA/VoiceOver test, contrast check, prefers-reduced-motion.

marie: Microcopy: Stop -> "Stop" tooltip "Stop — keep partial". Regenerate under overflow, replaces content + toast "Response replaced — Undo".

ash: Add subtle fade+lift animation; reduce motion when preferred.

sam: I'll prototype debounce + Esc to stop+focus-back.

ben: I'll draft the +N token microcopy and undo toast copy.

kai: I'll run a quick a11y pass on the comps.

marie: Thanks all — will post updated comps. :eyes:
